name: Summer Youth Internship Program (SYIP)
org: Miami-Dade County Public Schools, with partners
what_you_do: A 5 week summer job at a local business or group (hospitals such as Nicklaus Children's take part). Students also take a short online class before the internship.
who_can_apply: Rising 10th to 12th graders ages 15 to 18 enrolled in a Miami-Dade County Public School. Apply through your school champion. Students must complete the online pre-internship course.
pay_detail: Paid by stipend (amount not stated on the program pages); students open an EdFed Credit Union account for direct deposit
duration: 5 weeks (July 1 to Aug 2 in 2026), at least 30 hours a week
deadline_text: The 2026 session is over (July 1 to August 2, 2026). The page says to check back for 2027 registration details.
how_to_apply: Finish the first steps, including the online class before the internship. Talk to your teacher champion at school. Hotline: 305-693-3005.
notes: Students may earn school credit if they pass the review and finish their work. The page says to check back for 2027 sign up details.
